corpus.animationSources: Retained cartoon and Fossils excerpts, 96 frames each. Browser trials request four seconds, at 2x. Encoding comparisons use 360p; decoding and animation playback comparisons use 1080p.
corpus.flatHold: Synthetic 1080p60 three-second uniform hold with a 440 Hz tone, only a regression workload, not evidence for general video encoding performance.

detailPrefix.recipe: Copy the first 106 synchronized visual/audio chunks from every rendition, without refitting or recompressing payloads. Retain their durations and checksums, rewrite absolute offsets, and update chunks, frame/source counts, duration, average FPS and per-quality byte counts. Prefix coverage ends at the first shared boundary at or after ten seconds.
detailPrefix.claimLimit: Ten seconds of this source do not establish full two-minute playback or broader live-action coverage.

constrainedLinkCorrectness.conditions: Unit, native and end-to-end correctness jobs ran concurrently. These timings are diagnostics, not a controlled speed comparison.

forced100msCheckpoints.reason: Archive growth was excessive and repacking the 1080p cartoon exceeded a 16 MiB shared chunk. Production retains size-oriented packet selection.
forced100msCheckpoints.provenanceLimit: Temporary experimental binary hash was not captured; its timings are diagnostic only.

simdPrototype.reason: Intermediate decoder showed only a small completed-pixel improvement, insufficient here to justify a second decoder bundle. The shipped decoder remains portable.
simdPrototype.provenanceLimit: Intermediate-revision microbenchmark, not a comparison against the final decoder or a sustained-playback result.

initialLeadDeadlock.reason: Waiting for lead while future results occupied all capacity could stall preparation. Final readiness stops waiting at the image/event limit, and reservations protect the next contiguous event without double-reserving an in-flight image. Regression tests cover both cases.
